text:
Our review of “Infos” found no likely causes of problems in Frontify. One item is worth a quick check, though it is often fine as is:

1. Empty text frame
Empty frames are allowed, but are often left over by accident.
Where: a text frame on page 1
• Delete the frame if it isn’t needed.

If you change anything, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
